[SPDX detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48/json/details/radvd.json)

The unsigned annotated object gives v3.29.0 and commit target 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the revision of both radvd URLs. [Annotated tag](https://api.github.com/repos/spdx/license-list-data/git/tags/76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b)

challenge.method: Compare ordered lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs for the full grant, numbered conditions 0–5, acknowledgement and disclaimer. Isolate clause 4 to test the near-neighbor distinction documented by SPDX. Recheck both URL pins and compute full capture hashes independently.
challenge.results: All three bounded sequences match at 335 tokens. Clause 4 contributes 54 tokens including its marker, so dropping it gives 281 and breaks the comparison. The publisher differs from the SPDX pair by one trailing space on the acknowledgement line. There is no additional substantive publisher text outside the boundary.

limitations: The two SPDX files share the same publication lineage. The near-neighbor challenge uses the clause difference described in the radvd detail and a controlled omission, with no direct inspection of a separate Inner-Net-2.0 source.
The result concerns the captured COPYRIGHT passage. Index lifecycle assignments, legal equivalence, applicability to other versions or works, reuse and installation are outside scope.
reasoning: The exact radvd identifier and the complete 335-token documentary passage reconcile with both representations at the annotated release target.
